text_block_list.text:
And she's done it! Симболи Рудольф has
won her
third crown!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
As excited as the commentary is, it's
drowned out
entirely by the roar of the
crowd. As soon as they
realized this race
belonged to the Emperor, there
was no
stopping their cheers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for your support. With this
win...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: The Triple Crown is mine!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
An almost savage roar breaks out as a
new Triple
Crown Champion is born.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I did it, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And I must say, it was thrilling to hear
such a
large crowd cheering my name.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I went into this race thinking of it as
nothing more
than a means to an end...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But the title of Triple Crown Champion...
Well,
that does set my heart aflame!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф basks in the cheers for a
little
while longer...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Before lifting three fingers skyward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But her dream is only getting started!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now that I have claimed the Classic
Triple Crown,
it is obvious where I must
set my sights next.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The most fitting companion for the
honors I
already wear is...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Precisely.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Senior-year students will be taking part.

Competing against them will be a
golden
opportunity to demonstrate my
prowess.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And besides, if the fans choose me to
participate,
that would be an honor in
and of itself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Even the Arima Kinen is but a stepping
stone to
greater glories.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Just as we resolve to fix our sights on the
Arima
Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm coming in.
Good work out there, Prez.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian. It's not often you come to
watch me
race.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I was interested in seeing who the
strongest
Umamusume was.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And as expected, it's you. Looks like the
Kikuka
Sho was no sweat for the
Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I could hardly presume to give you
orders if I
wasn't.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I'd love to go toe-to-toe with you
someday. You
look like an opponent
worth sinking my teeth
into.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
By all means. I'm confident I can weather
a gentle
nibble.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Hmph.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, enough of that. Is Эйр Грув
not with
you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was egotistical of me to
assume that
she would be watching... Or
could it be that she
has something to
attend to?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You know, probing people isn't really
your speed.
You make it too obvious.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: That's not what I—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Are you worried she won't follow you if
you don't
keep an eye on her?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Excuse me?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Never mind. Congrats on the Triple
Crown.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Get some rest. You've earned it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Of course. Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You know, Trainer... About what Brian
just said—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'm from the newspaper. Do
you have
a minute?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Of course. Just give me a moment to get
ready.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We can pick this up later. The press is
calling.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Between my new rank of Triple Crown
Champion
and my future ambitions, I
have plenty for them
to get excited
about.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
In the end, however, Симболи Рудольф
winds up
swamped with interviews, and
we never get the
chance to have that
talk.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
